job_information.job_description: We are looking for a photoreal 3D animator to produce 12 short clips of our warehouse autonomous mobile robot picking cases off a pallet and placing them on a conveyor. Blender or Maya, hard-surface modelling, realistic cloth and cable motion, clean studio lighting. Deliver MP4 (1080p and 4K) plus the source files so we can re-cut them ourselves. Roughly 4 minutes of finished animation, wanted within a 3-week window. Please show one example of hard-surface machinery work.
